results.name: a Search Party result name stays readable: no more lines than its length needs (no one-letter-per-line wrap)
the search box and the type filter do not overlap and each keeps a usable width
APEX incident rows keep each card at least 200 px wide (the action wraps below on a phone)
the product rail starts with "Investor start"
every rail link opens a native page, except an area still being migrated, which says so and links to where it runs natively
the Commissioning boundary page has a sentence-case heading and links only to native pages that run the same engine
status tags, tab counters and tour dots are at least 12 px
no page error across these pages
